name: The Octagon

location.text: 1799 New York Avenue NW, Washington, D.C.

dates.altered: Original flat roof replaced ca. 1825 (survey data form).
dates.note: The HABS data form prints 'DATE OF CONSTRUCTION (INCLUDESOURCE) 1798-1800'; the Wikipedia infobox prints 'Built 1799' and its text 'erected between 1799 and 1800'. Recorded as the survey states it.

note: Written 4 Sep 2026. A one-page data form: it names the Federal kit (belt course, recessed panels between floors, fanlight, one-storey Ionic porch) and states no dimension beyond the storey count; the 12 measured drawings were not read.
